Bubble Bath THCA Flower Preferred / 28g Strain Profile Bubble Bath THCA Flower is an Emerald Cup 2023 winning hybrid bred from The Soap crossed with Project 4516 . The cross delivers a flavor-led cultivar with clean, herbal-musk character and dense, well-structured buds — the kind of award-decorated genetics that earn shelf space on flavor and effects alone. Effects Bubble Bath delivers an uplifting, happy onset paired with a comfortable, body-easy baseline. The high stays cheerful and conversational without tipping into heavy sedation — making this a flexible cultivar for daytime social use, late-afternoon decompression, or evening unwinding. A genuinely versatile, award-grade hybrid. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: clean herbal-soap up front (the trademark Soap parent signature), with a subtle creamy middle and a smooth, lightly sweet finish on the exhale. Smoke is silky and refreshingly different from typical fruit-or-dessert hybrids. The terpene profile reads clean-and-musky — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Bubble Bath harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Bubble Bath THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Bubble Bath THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. effects_provenance.raw: Sherbanger THCA Flower Essential / 28g (Smalls) Strain Profile Sherbanger THCA Flower is a balanced hybrid bred from Sherbet crossed with Headbanger . The cross combines Sherbet's creamy dessert character with Headbanger's bold, gas-forward depth — producing a uniquely contrasting flavor profile and dense, well-structured buds with strong bag appeal. Effects Sherbanger delivers a versatile, well-balanced high suitable for various occasions. The cerebral side stays mood-lifting and conversational; the body baseline relaxes without becoming heavy — making this a flexible cultivar for daytime use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: creamy sherbet up front, with a sharp gas middle and a smooth, lightly fruit-leaning finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and unmistakably contrasting. The terpene profile reads cream-and-gas — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Sherbanger harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Sherbanger THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Sherbanger THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains.
